description: This file defines the class BuzzEmbeddedURL, which processes a video URL to generate an embedded video URL for platforms like YouTube, Vimeo, and Dailymotion. It employs an internal caching mechanism and handles validation through exceptions.

classes.name: BuzzEmbeddedURL
classes.description: Handles URL processing and embedding for different video platforms, with internal caching and validation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with the provided URL.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Attempts to generate an embedded URL for supported video platforms using URL pattern matching.

methods.name: isValidURL
methods.description: Determines if the current URL can be embedded, returning true if valid.
